title: Help me to remember You
cue: What the Prophet ﷺ told Mu'adh never to leave after a prayer
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You well.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sunan Abi Dawud, ed. Muhyi al-Din Abd al-Hamid, hadith 1522: https://shamela.ws/book/1726/2039

when: At the end of every prayer
usage.evidence: The Prophet ﷺ took Mu'adh by the hand, told him twice that he loved him, and said: never leave saying this at the end of every prayer (Abu Dawud 1522).
